scenario.summary: Threat actors use SEO poisoning and malvertising to lure users to fake verification pages (ClickFix) that trick them into executing malicious PowerShell commands from their clipboard. These commands download multi-stage payloads that establish persistence through scheduled tasks and Run keys, eventually deploying DLL sideloading chains for reverse SSH tunnels or Node.js-based RATs.

meta.rationale: Look for endpoints with recent software installation errors or those reporting high PowerShell script block volume. Prioritize hosts where ProgramData contains new, single-character or random-character subdirectories.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker has established persistence using ClickFix-dropped batch scripts that install DLL sideloading implants and reverse SSH tunnels to maintain long-term access.

hunt.name: Persistence via Sideloading and Reverse Tunnels
hunt.description: This hunt targets the persistent phase of ClickFix campaigns where initial script execution leads to established footholds. It focuses on non-standard Registry Run keys pointing to ProgramData staging paths, identifies rare module loads that indicate DLL sideloading, and corroborates these findings with network connections to known reverse-tunnel infrastructure. An agent weighs the persistence, module prevalence, and network telemetry to identify compromised hosts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, reg_target, reg_value_data, reg_value_name, time FROM hb_registry_activity WHERE (LOWER(reg_target) LIKE '%\currentversion\run%' OR LOWER(reg_target) LIKE '%\currentversion\runonce%') AND (LOWER(reg_value_data) LIKE '%c:\programdata\%' OR instr(',' || '{{target_run_paths}}' || ',', ',' || reg_value_name || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find Run keys that point to scripts or binaries staged in ProgramData, matching specific campaign patterns.
config.expected_signal: A Run key pointing to a ProgramData path or using a known campaign value name. Silence means no such persistence was identified via Registry.

config.content: SELECT module_name, module_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_load FROM hb_module_activity WHERE LOWER(module_path) LIKE 'c:\programdata\%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY module_name, module_path HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Stack-count module loads from ProgramData to identify rare DLLs that may be sideloaded.
config.expected_signal: A module load from a ProgramData subdirectory occurring on only a few hosts across the fleet.
